svg.text: Layout A from above: collimator in a cube
everything up to the collimator in standard cubes, grating and camera on a spectrograph plate; 6 x 4 base plate (ASS-1008). Footprint 6 × 3 cells.
Lines: 532 nm laser (green, from the laser to the sample), Raman light at 540 / 610 / 680 nm (from the sample to the camera).
